criteria.intent: Complete source-bounded analysis and exact input accounting.
criteria.automated_scope: Original inputs and supplied snapshot contracts, candidate mappings, access limits, UI metric parsing and actual admitted metadata. Recorded evidence is checked; source reading/authenticity/live counts are separate observations in the dated review.

criteria.intent: Confident bounded advisory and response presentation without overcrowding.
criteria.automated_scope: Generated three Home cards, two UA advisors and six other Research responses; unique profiles, all existing source links, exact bounded roles and declared copy delta. Automated structure is not editorial or independent acceptance.

criteria.automated_scope: All 27 original primary identities and five featured selections survive; 20 readable LinkedIn inputs are represented once, two remain deferred, two new primaries are explicit. Per-platform dates, normalized duplicates and primary-only visible/schema counts are checked. Body equivalence is not asserted. Permanent site-engine/archive suites own renderer/security/filter faults and normal Basic CI; bounded browser observations remain separate.

criteria.intent: Honest community context and clear research lenses.
criteria.automated_scope: Three canonical Research rows match the supplied snapshots; only rounded views/comments render, with capture-date and reader/reply limits. Writing has two related discussion links; discussions do not enter work counts or structured data. TOC primer and Control Theory heading are checked; criticism is not validation.

criteria.intent: Preserve SEO, semantics, original editions and runtime behavior.
criteria.automated_scope: All five pages reconcile to the immutable SEO baseline after the exact reviewed Issue41 amendment and earlier declared deltas. Metadata, old edition identity and all unrelated semantics remain exact. Under the maintainer joint-staging amendment, runtime/scene logic and workflows exactly match the immutable #36 companion 73020e8; catalog/edition comparison stays at c4539ad; archive.js changes only its exact print status label to cover multiple linked editions. Enduring SEO mutation cases and normal preview smoke complement this task snapshot; no ranking or release claim.

criteria.intent: Actionable same-PR handoff, current test/RI routes and honest closure.
criteria.automated_scope: Current implementation checks execute once in the selected raw-head acceptance workflow. Basic/source-targeted CI and navigation/RI verify their independent routes. The same-PR analysis records the explicit preparation-to-implementation transition; live CI/commit linkage, independent review, actual issue checkbox reconciliation and merge remain recorded gates.

EDITORIAL.description: Source/editorial review of exact roles and contribution verbs, admitted editions and per-platform dates, neutral Reddit disposition, public and structured-data claim boundaries, before/after semantics and actual readable layout. Preserve separate existing rights/device/release owners; do not invent source access or advisor correspondence inspection. Reddit numbers require the dated snapshot note; community criticism and the supplied historical claims are not validation.

REVIEW-MERGE.description: Record independent review honestly, exact current-source Basic/targeted/navigation/acceptance and preview artifacts, live PR/Refs commits at the issue anchor, actual AC checkbox reconciliation and maintainer merge decision. Compare merged source with accepted candidate before closure; implementation is not release approval.

BROWSER.description: Inspect matching current-source PR Chromium smoke and targeted Home/Research/Writing Day/Night desktop/narrow layout, advisory anchors, filters/history/print, Off/reduced motion and bottom reach. Record report/public digest/source binding; this policy cannot ingest hosted reports. Separate first-release physical-device requirements remain with their owners.
